lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct vertical white lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is non-uniform, with a higher frequency in the posterior region and wider gaps between the 5th and 8th lines across the mid-section.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 2nd and 3rd lines from the posterior terminate at approximately 50% of the torso height; the 9th line is fragmented and does not reach the dorsal ridge.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The visible right horn follows a spiral lyrate path, initiating with a posterior-lateral vector from the skull before curving medially and dorsally.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tip constitutes approximately 12-15% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron mark present between the eyes; two distinct white spots aligned vertically on the mid-cheek; white patch on the lower throat; white bands present on the upper portion of the tan-colored lower limbs.
